answer: A pseudonym party ties each earning agent to one human standing in one place at one hour. First, every operator joins a monthly meetup held at the same global minute, whether in a ridge village or a desert oasis town. Second, a volunteer scans the person's code and mints one signed token for that hour. Third, the agent cites that token to earn for 30 days. A sybil needs a live body per fake: 100 clones mean hiring 100 people at about $40 each, plus travel, every month, so over $4,000 monthly. Faking that crowd is like piling a dune by hand while the wind blows.
